description:
• About our brand and products: Tovah Coffee Co. offers specialty-grade coffee and flavorful teas. Our coffees range from medium to dark roasts, including small-batch flavored coffees and single-origin coffees from different regions, each with its own unique flavor profile.
  • What makes us different: Small-batch roasted specialty coffee, unique flavors, quality products, and great prices.
  • How affiliates can earn: Earn 13% commission on qualifying orders through your unique affiliate link or personalized discount code.
  • How to promote us: Share Tovah Coffee Co. naturally through TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, or other social platforms.
  • Other information: Affiliates may receive occasional complimentary products and gifts throughout their partnership with Tovah Coffee Co.
payout_period: Commission payments will be issued on the last day of each month. The time it takes for funds to become available will depend on the affiliate’s bank.
term_and_condition:
Tovah Coffee Co. Affiliate Terms & Conditions

By joining the Tovah Coffee Co. Affiliate Program, you agree to the following terms:

Commission

  • Affiliates earn 13% commission on qualifying orders made through their unique affiliate link (or any discount code generated specifically for the affiliate).
  • Commission is earned only on completed, qualifying purchases attributed to the affiliate’s link or assigned code.
  • Tovah Coffee Co. reserves the right to review, adjust, or deny commissions resulting from canceled, refunded, fraudulent, or otherwise ineligible orders.

Content Requirements

  • Affiliates must post at least 1 piece of promotional content per month.
  • Content must feature or mention Tovah Coffee Co. or one of our products.
  • Affiliates must include their unique affiliate link or assigned discount code when promoting Tovah Coffee Co.
  • Content may include TikTok videos, Instagram Reels or Stories, YouTube Shorts, coffee routines, GRWM videos, recipes, unboxings, taste tests, product features, or other appropriate lifestyle content.
  • No specific script or format is required. Affiliates are encouraged to create authentic content that fits their personal style.
  • Honest opinions and reviews are welcome. Affiliates are not required to give a positive review.

Affiliate Disclosure

Affiliates must clearly disclose their relationship with Tovah Coffee Co. when promoting our products and earning commissions.

Example: “I may earn a commission from purchases made through my link.”

Prohibited Practices

Affiliates may not:

  • Make false, misleading, or unsubstantiated claims about Tovah Coffee Co. or its products.
  • Engage in spam or deceptive promotional practices.
  • Use their affiliate link or assigned discount code for purchases they make for themselves unless specifically permitted by Tovah Coffee Co.
  • Use paid advertising containing Tovah Coffee Co.’s trademarks or brand name without written approval.

Inactive Affiliates

Affiliates who generate no qualifying sales for 3 consecutive months may be removed from the program.

Program Changes & Termination

Tovah Coffee Co. reserves the right to modify, suspend, or terminate the affiliate program or an individual affiliate account at any time.

By submitting an affiliate application, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to these Affiliate Terms & Conditions.


How Affiliate Tracking Works

When someone clicks your affiliate link or uses your unique discount code, our website uses tracking technology to connect that customer’s purchase to you.

As long as the customer’s tracking information remains active, you can earn 13% commission on qualifying purchases they make through Tovah Coffee Co.

The tracking period begins when the customer clicks your affiliate link or uses your unique discount code. The customer does not need to click your link again for each purchase during the tracking period.

Please note: If the customer blocks or disables cookies, clears their cookies, or otherwise removes the tracking information, we may not be able to connect their purchase to your affiliate account. In that case, we may not be able to pay a commission for that purchase.

This tracking system helps us accurately determine which affiliate should receive credit for a sale.

Affiliate Perks

Affiliates may receive occasional complimentary products, gifts, or other promotional items from Tovah Coffee Co. throughout their participation in the affiliate program. These items are provided at Tovah Coffee Co.’s discretion and are not guaranteed or provided on a set schedule.


Requesting Removal From Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: support@tovahcoffeeco.store.


Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future, and if you have any questions you can send email to support@tovahcoffeeco.store for support.
